Data & methodology

Named third-party integrators only. Volume share and Top 5 share use the sum of their volume. NEAR.com, unknown tags and untagged swaps are excluded from these rankings. Each interface is counted once; routing layers are not added again.

Volume change compares the previous period of the same length. Added volume ranks the dollar increase. These rolling periods overlap and are not a daily time series. Fees and revenue per integrator are not provided by this source.

App identities follow the provider’s mappings. A small dot marks mappings the provider has not verified.
